typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ACTION_CD as string,
		COMPANY_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT2_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT_UNIT_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT4_NBR as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		ACCT_FM_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT_ID as string,
		BRCH_FM_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		ACCT_PRFT_CTR_CD as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		PROD_CD as string,
		BRCH_TO_CD as string,
		ACCT_TO_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT1_NBR as string,
		MISC_FLAGS_TXT as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT3_NBR as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		RECORD_TYPE_CD as string,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ACTION_CD as string,
		COMPANY_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT2_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT_UNIT_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT4_NBR as string,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ACCT_FM_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT_ID as string,
		BRCH_FM_CD as string,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		ACCT_PRFT_CTR_CD as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		PROD_CD as string,
		BRCH_TO_CD as string,
		ACCT_TO_CD as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT1_NBR as string,
		MISC_FLAGS_TXT as string,
		ORACLE_ACCT3_NBR as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		RECORD_TYPE_CD as string,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 39000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ACTION_CD,
		COMPANY_CD,
		ORACLE_ACCT2_NBR,
		ACCOUNT_UNIT_CD,
		ORACLE_ACCT4_NBR,
		EFFDATE,
		ACCT_FM_CD,
		ORACLE_ACCT_ID,
		BRCH_FM_CD,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		ACCT_PRFT_CTR_CD,
		EFFECTIVEDATE,
		PROD_CD,
		BRCH_TO_CD,
		ACCT_TO_CD,
		ORACLE_ACCT1_NBR,
		MISC_FLAGS_TXT,
		ORACLE_ACCT3_NBR,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		RECORD_TYPE_CD,
		UPDT_LAST_TMSTP),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
